How it works

  1. Pick a slot above and pay via Buy Me a Coffee, Ko-fi, GitHub Sponsors, or email.
  2. Reply to the confirmation with your creative (text + link, or a 728x90 banner for the top slot).

Why sponsor an API directory?

Developers who browse an API directory are actively choosing what to integrate. That is the highest-intent audience in developer marketing - not passive readers, but people with a decision to make right now. A sponsored slot puts your API in front of them at exactly that moment.
